The smaller-magnitude fallback is deterministic: distinct adjacent numerical values cannot straddle zero because zero is representable.

criteria.change: Add to §13.1: “The nearest-even PPC tie rule also governs nearest-even selection for the constrained carrier transcendentals of §13.4.”

criteria.evidence: The proposal preserves all format and input-domain obligations and restores deterministic numerical selection required by North Star §§3.2 and 5.1. Its mixed-fat-object statement and incorporated scope note preserve native host execution, closure-specific certificates and explicit remaining mixed-launch obligations. The standing check passes.

criteria.evidence: The proposed rule defines integer significands, zero parity, sign handling, a deterministic fallback and preservation of other rounding modes. An implementer can implement the selection without another numerical decision. The replacement leaves awkward punctuation before the inherited NaN/inf clause, but no competing semantics.
criteria.change: End the replacement with: “Directed and nearest-away modes retain their specified rules. NaN and infinity are represented in the high component with low +0.” Remove the inherited “and NaN/inf represented…” fragment and retain the following overflow sentence.

suggestions: In “Hashes, catalog and consumers”, replace the automatic mapping-version claim with: “The full dialect compatibility version and consumer pins change; dialect_mapping_version changes only when the separately declared lifting-map version changes.” Retain map 0.2.9 and map 0.3 unless the publication explicitly amends their declarations and certificate bindings.

In “Conformance vectors”, supply executable mode expectations for both witnesses. With positive adjacent candidates L and U, the results for nearest-even/down/up/toward-zero/nearest-away are L/L/U/L/U; for the negated inputs they are -L/-U/-L/-L/-U. Each observed-exception case raises exactly 16; an initial unrelated sticky bit 32 therefore yields flags 48.

Replace “Include a direct test of the equal-parity fallback” with: “Test the equal-parity selector branch independently. Count such a test as an arithmetic conformance vector only when its candidates are shown to be adjacent canonical values.” This preserves the defensive policy without assuming that a reachable binary64 example exists.
In the exact diff, separate the inherited nonfinite clause into: “NaN and infinity are represented in the high component with low +0.” Keep the existing overflow and underflow sentences unchanged.
path_to_accept: No blocking changes are required. Apply through the recommended new full dialect version and matching draft amendment. Correcting the separately versioned mapping-binding claim would raise C5 from 4 to 5.
summary: Accept. The numerical defect is real, both witnesses and incorrect native flags reproduce, and the proposed tie rule repairs the ambiguity without narrowing capability. The publication route and unchanged ISA catalog are appropriate. Correct the nonblocking claim that a dialect-version bump automatically changes the lifting-map binding.
